notes: Both לָבֶטַח phrases and עָלֶיהָ are rule 30 fusions, the ASV writing one English word for each pair; the לָבֶטַח units head on the noun carrying the lexeme and 'therein' on the preposition carrying the relation.

The object marker before אֹתָם is unrepresented here, unlike v.24, because the ASV writes 'do them despite' with the object bare rather than reaching it through 'unto' — rule 16's subtraction test applied per occurrence, not per lemma.
מִן is unrepresented and 'round about' belongs wholly to סְבִיבוֹת (rules 40, 31).
